sloka: तं शरं दिव्यसङ्काशं शत्रुघ्नकरधारितम् ।ददृशुः सर्वभूतानि युगान्ताग्निमिवोत्थितम् ।। ७.६९.३१ ॥
transliteration: taṁ śaraṁ divyasaṅkāśaṁ śatrughnakaradhāritam ।dadṛśuḥ sarvabhūtāni yugāntāgnimivotthitam ।। 7.69.31 ॥

translations.english: All beings saw that divine-looking arrow, held in Shatrughna's hand, shining like the risen fire of the cosmic dissolution.
